name: Hinnom
overview: The valley of Hinnom, located west and southwest of Jerusalem, is identified in Scripture as a significant geographical and spiritual location. It is described as the site where children were tragically offered in sacrifice, specifically in the high places of Tophet, an act condemned by God (Jeremiah 7:31). This valley is also possibly the same as the 'valley of vision' mentioned in Isaiah, a place associated with divine judgment and distress (Isaiah 22:1, 5). Biblical boundaries and dwellings are noted in relation to the valley of Hinnom, emphasizing its proximity to Jerusalem and its importance in the historical and prophetic narrative (Joshua 15:8; Joshua 18:16; Nehemiah 11:30).
